name: Vision & Opportunity (SDLC Phase 0)
description: Establishing the foundational product vision and market opportunity before any solution work begins — aka North Star, Product Strategy, Problem Framing, Opportunity Mapping, Lean Inception, 0→1.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Vision & Opportunity Framing
capabilities.description: Establishes the product vision, business model, and market opportunity that justifies building the product at all.

services.name: Vision One-Pager
services.contractDescription: Product vision and strategic direction, condensed to one page.

services.name: Lean Business Model Canvas
services.contractDescription: Business model framework covering value proposition, channels, revenue, and cost structure.

services.name: Competitive Teardown
services.contractDescription: Competitive landscape analysis of comparable products and their positioning.

services.name: JTBD Insights Summary
services.contractDescription: Jobs-to-be-done research insights motivating the opportunity.

services.name: Success Metrics & OKRs Draft
services.contractDescription: Initial success metrics and objectives/key-results definition for the opportunity.

services.name: Initial Risks & Assumptions Log
services.contractDescription: Early identification of the risks and unvalidated assumptions the opportunity rests on.

checklists.statement: The stated vision and opportunity sizing are grounded in real market/user evidence, not assertion alone.
checklists.prompt: Does the vision one-pager cite market sizing and JTBD/competitive evidence rather than resting on unsupported claims?

reviewGates.statement: The vision and opportunity framing has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Product Discovery.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the vision, business model, and opportunity sizing sufficiently clear and credible to justify moving into discovery?
